answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, withering like a vine in a cold zephyr. A fake farm can flash briefly, but every idle clone's weight thins the instant it stops contributing at the jetty. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding labor bill they cannot sustain.
